text: Working on it — the proxy balancer panics (divide by zero / index out of range) when it has no targets; I'm making Next return nil and the middleware answer 503.
Got it — investigating router.go for the no-routable-path case (likely a panic/wrong match in Router.Find).

Fixed in middleware/proxy.go: randomBalancer.Next and roundRobinBalancer.Next now return nil when there are no targets (previously they panicked with a divide-by-zero / index-out-of-range), and ProxyWithConfig returns echo.ErrServiceUnavailable (503) when the balancer yields no target. Full test suite still green.

Fixed in context.go: Scheme() now only accepts valid scheme values (http/https) from X-Forwarded-Proto, X-Forwarded-Protocol and X-Url-Scheme; invalid values are ignored and it falls through (to the next header, or to "http"), matching the documented contract that Scheme returns "http" or "https". All pre-existing tests still pass.

Fixed in bind.go: bindData now handles map destinations properly — map[string][]string gets the full value slice (previously it panicked trying to store a string into a []string), map[string]string/interface{} keep binding the first value, scalar element types are converted, and unsupported map types return an error instead of panicking.

Fixed in middleware/compress.go: gzipResponseWriter.Write no longer forwards zero-length writes to the gzip writer, which used to emit the 10-byte gzip header for empty responses (leaving an undecodable non-empty body after the Content-Encoding header was stripped). Empty responses now have an empty body; all gzip tests pass.

Status: I've fuzzed Router.Find/insert against a reference matcher (many route sets, non-routable paths, empty router, 405 cases) and haven't yet reproduced the no-routable-path failure; still narrowing it down in router.go. Will report as soon as I have the fix.

Status: group.go's Use/Add/Group paths look correct for the multi-group scenarios I tested (per-group middleware is applied per route, no panics). Still hunting the exact TestMultipleGroupSamePathMiddleware failure; will report when fixed.
